posts.cooked:
Hello everyone. If anyone remember in a earlier post i did a tournament with my friend where we banned a character then force the other play to play one character then drafted with no over lapping charcters until a four hero team was made.
ps. I won no loss to his 3

So we are going to be starting the next one in about a month and we are doing it pretty much the same with a few more things involved. Now if a hero dies we cant use them again throughout the tournament. So if we run out of characters to play we lose so dying (like he did) will be devastating(aurora). I put in a system on how to gain heros back. We are going to have to fight spite on advance mode to win one hero back. We can choose the team we want from the “living” heros. Now if a hero is incaped during this battle it will be treated as if it was in the tournament. So it must be a really good character to risk four to get. Also if a hero fights in one match and precedes to fight in the next match will have the same health as the ending health of the previous match.

So now that I’ve explained this tournament, does anyone want to suggest new stuff to the tournament so we can implement it before we start hence why i say it in a month in advance

Also i will be editing it when we add your suggestions

posts.cooked: You can use the same hero two battles in a row if you want, but if you do, they start at the HP they left off at the battle before (they need some time to recover after a fight after all). That way you have to use different characters
